Warnings can be dismissed from Settings → Warnings → “In this plan now”: Dismiss beside one works as it does from the plant (hardiness, poison and fruit partners go for every copy of that plant in the plan), and a dismissed one says who it’s dismissed for.
With more than one warning of a kind there, Dismiss all and Show all again take care of them at once, with an Undo. For crowding they take the place of Leave all flagged now and Flag them again.
